Name: Pragma Assets, Inc.
Description:
We are an asset management company that bases its analysis and investment decisions exclusively on science.

Our methodology applies three scientific disciplines to publicly traded companies: Chemistry. Physics. Systems Theory.

This is not algorithmic trading.
We focus exclusively on medium- and long-term investing horizons: 3, 5, 10, 15, and 20 years.

For the first time, companies are analyzed as chemical systems.
Each company is decomposed into “atoms” — every operational component and every element of its financial reporting. These elements are treated as chemical components, allowing us to study their interactions, dependencies, and structural influence on the whole system.

This approach has never before been applied to stock market analysis.
As a result, Pragma Assets operates on a methodology that is both unique and scientifically grounded.

By analyzing companies at a structural level, we identify deep patterns and systemic behaviors that remain invisible to traditional financial analysis.

Over time and across real-world application, this methodology has demonstrated its ability to construct portfolios that systematically outperform the market over medium- and long-term horizons.

Pragma Assets, Inc. evolved from Research Institute of Stock Exchange, Inc. (2022–2024) and later Scientific Technology Capital, Inc. (2024–2025), reflecting the firm’s continuous evolution and commitment to a scientific approach to asset management.

PCM believes intensity is the price of excellence. We loathe uncalculated, unappreciated, unnecessary risk. Leverage is important in maximizing returns, particularly when money is cheap - but not to the point of handicapping the firm. At the core of our investment philosophy, we ask 4 questions. If the answer isn’t yes to each question, we do not invest regardless of potential return:
•	Will this investment change lives?
•	Are we passionate about it?
•	Are we good at it? / Do we understand it?
•	Does it have market value? 
We tend to follow many of Ben Graham’s principles, though not strictly through a pass/fail lens. We invest in companies following these basic rules:
1.	Don’t buy any company for more than its book value.
2.	Always buy based on the margin of safety.
3.	Don’t chase returns.
4.	Investment operation promises safety of principal and an adequate return.
5.     Company analysis/soundness of its underlying businesses.
6.     Deliberately protect against serious losses.
7.	PCM has no interest in being temporarily right. To reach long-term financial goals, we must be sustainably and reliably right. We aim to be wrong small and right big.
8.     Adequate not excessive diversification - defined as 10-20 issues.

Our current portfolio includes BCB Bancorp (BCBP), Apple Hospitality REIT (APLE), British American Tobacco (BTI), Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP), and Main Street Capital (MAIN).

PCM also owns and manages The Dunes on Spring, a $2.2M STR duplex with 5 bedrooms in downtown Charleston as well as The Ashley and 1837 B&B, two historic beautifully renovated 9-suite B&Bs also in downtown each Charleston valued at $5M.

Name: AGENA Investment Management
Description:
AGENA Investment Management LLC specializes in volatility-controlled portfolio construction that preserves capital and reduces risk during periods of sustained volatility while realizing gains in trending markets producing a significant compounded growth effect over time. AGENA provides a unique solution to market volatility by capitalizing on the inefficiencies of the options hedging market that allows the strategy to buy low and sell high during periods of persistently high realized market volatility. This creates a positive return stream during periods of market volatility similar to downside protection but without paying the high cost of volatility carry. During lower volatility or “trending” regimes, the strategy looks to track the market. The net result of these two risk exposures is a return stream that can be described as convex -- with low downside deviation and a low max drawdown, especially when compared to traditional benchmarks like the S&P 500. AGENA’s strategies are model driven based on econometrics and broad market structures. This removes emotions and investor sentiment and allows the model to profit from inefficiencies these bring to the market.

The Fund will use the proceeds from the sale of Trust Units to purchase Class A Partnership Units in the Partnership.  The Partnership will use the proceeds from the issuance of Class A Partnership Units, less Partnership Expense, the Redemption Reserve, the Operating Reserve. to purchase Diamonds. The Fund will only qualify as a Mutual Fund Trust when the number of Trust Unitholders reaches 150.

Profits, if any, realized from the acquisition, appreciation and sale of Diamonds will ultimately form the basis of Trust Distributions. The Fund will will use the proceeds received from the Partnership Distributions to pay Trust Distributions to Unitholders.  Effectively, potential profits will be split 80/20 with the General Partner.

The Partnership expects to hold Diamonds for a period of approximately five to ten years from the date of the Final Closing and will dispose of the Diamonds, in its sole discretion, as is commercially opportune.

The General Partner believes that the acquisition of Diamonds provide a substantial competitive advantage based upon the following factors:
- diamonds, especially investment grade, are rare;
- diamond prices have shown consistent growth over the last 10 years;
- the trajectory on prices indicates a continued rise in the value of investment grade diamonds; 
- the diamond industry is anticipated to encounter a supply and demand gap;
- consumer demand is increasing

Name: New Day Funding
Description:
NDF is your turnkey solution for owning your own portfolio of Mortgage Notes.

There are billions of dollars’ worth of outstanding, distressed mortgage debt in the U.S.  In today’s economy, more and more people are experiencing financial hardship and having difficulty paying their mortgage.  Banks typically write these non-performing assets off as toxic and sell them to investment groups. WHY?.... OUR INVESTMENT PHILOSOPHY

While every investment will expose you to risk, we believe that wise management practices can help mitigate this exposure and provide the greatest opportunity for reward.

We look for out-of-favor stocks that trade at discounts to their long term average Price/Earnings multiples. Fundamental Analysis
We deeply scrutinize earnings cycles, P/E ratios, and total debt to assure that a company’s stock is fundamentally sound.

Technical Analysis
We look for support levels, resistance levels, and breakout areas – investigating reasons for historic growth and decline, and potential for the future.

Psychological Analysis
We search for stocks that traditional analysts have given up on. Out-of-favor stocks often mean an improved cost basis for our customers. 

Mr. Millegan and his staff personally determine the stocks and bonds to be purchased for your accounts, and how much will be spent on each position. Additionally, we diversify accounts by identifying stocks in different industries and investment styles. We classify stocks into three distinct investment style categories; Traditional, Global Franchise and Dynamic Growth.

Once a stock has been identified as acceptable and a position approved for purchase, a clear and precise buy and sell point is established. When the stock hits the sell target it is sold.

Name: Talanton Capital
Description:
The Greek word "τάλαντον" (pronounced talanton) means "talent," which was an ancient unit of weight that signified a considerable sum of money. The term is mostly commonly known from the biblical Parable of the Talents (Matthew 25:14-30) in which a man departs his home for lengthy journey, but before he leaves, entrusts his three servants with five talents, two talents, and one talent respectively, each "according to his own ability." During his absence, the first two servants trade with the talents and double the capital commended to their care. The servant with one talent, however, buries it in a field. Upon his return, the man rewards those who increased the value of their talents, but punishes the lazy servant and casts him "into the outer darkness."

At Talanton Capital, we seek to be good stewards of what has been entrusted to us by God--be it money, time, or an education. It is our mission to offer the students of Franciscan University the opportunity to gain authentic finance experience and connect them to insights from highly skilled industry professionals. To that end, Talanton Capital is structured to be an investment fund whose portfolio is researched and managed entirely by students. In addition to our work with public equities, we will host a number of workshops and speakers to supplement our peers' education and prepare them to break into the world of high finance.

The future growth of the global economy will likely be dependent on these developing economies, which make up nearly 40% of global GDP. 

Emerging Market economies rarely move as one, nor do their equity markets. It is imperative to assess the macro risks that are at play in each country and make investment decisions based on this analysis. 

There are tens of thousands of companies operating in Emerging Markets. We have found that investing in quality companies can generate superior returns over time. We believe one of the main reasons to invest in Emerging Markets is for their superior growth potential. We therefore focus on companies that have secular growth. We also believe that better returns can be achieved by a more concentrated approach rather than buying ‘the market’. 

Sustainability is core to what we do, across countries, industries and companies.

OUR INVESTMENT PHILOSOPHY

While every investment will expose you to risk, we believe that wise management practices can help mitigate this exposure and provide the greatest opportunity for reward.

We are contrarian, aggressive and proactive. Yet our mission is focused, logical and disciplined. J.W. Millegan carefully screens stocks with these distinct criteria:

Fundamental Analysis
We deeply scrutinize earnings cycles, P/E ratios, and total debt to assure that a company’s stock is fundamentally sound.

Technical Analysis
We look for support levels, resistance levels, and breakout areas – investigating reasons for historic growth and decline, and potential for the future.

Psychological Analysis
We search for stocks that traditional analysts have given up on. Out-of-favor stocks often mean an improved cost basis for our customers. 

Mr. Millegan and his staff personally determine the stocks and bonds to be purchased for your accounts, and how much will be spent on each position. Additionally, we diversify accounts by identifying stocks in different industries and investment styles. We classify stocks into three distinct investment style categories; Traditional, Global Franchise and Dynamic Growth.

Once a stock has been identified as acceptable and a position approved for purchase, a clear and precise buy and sell point is established. When the stock hits the sell target it is sold.

Name: Valhalla Diamond Fund
Description:
Valhalla Diamond Trust (the "Fund") was established to provide Trust Unitholders with the opportunity to participate in the returns available on the acquisition, appreciation and sale of Diamonds by the Partnership.  The Fund believes that there exists an opportunity to see a potential gain form the appreciation of Diamonds.

The Fund is a private investment platform for retail investors.  The Fund was formed to qualify as a mutual fund trust.  Pursuant to the Offering, the Fund will issue Trust Units to qualified Subscribers through registered Dealers and their advisors.  The Fund will use the proceeds from the sale of Trust Units to purchase Class A Partnership Units in the Partnership.  The Partnership will use the proceeds from the issuance of Class A Partnership Units, less Partnership Expense, the Redemption Reserve, the Operating Reserve. to purchase Diamonds.  The Fund will continue to use the gross proceeds from each Closing in order to purchase Class A Partnership Units and the Partnership will continue to use the proceeds from the issuance of Class A Partnership Units to purchase Diamonds.  The Fund will only qualify as a Mutual Fund Trust when the number of Trust Unitholders reaches 150.

Profits, if any, realized from the acquisition, appreciation and sale of Diamonds will ultimately form the basis of Trust Distributions.  The Partnership intends to utilize a portion of the cash flow generated from the sale of Diamonds to pay Partnership Distributions, in such amounts determined from time to time by the General Partner, and only after paying the Partnership Expenses, the Redemptions Reserve, and the Operating Reserve.  The Fund will will use the proceeds received from the Partnership Distributions to pay Trust Distributions to Unitholders.  Effectively, potential profits will be split 80/20 with the General Partner.

The Partnership expects to hold Diamonds for a period of approximately five to ten years from the date of the Final Closing and will dispose of the Diamonds, in its sole discretion, as is commercially opportune.

The General Partner believes that the acquisition of Diamonds provide a substantial competitive advantage based upon the following factors:
- diamonds, especially investment grade, are rare;
- diamond prices have shown consistent growth over the last 10 years;
- the trajectory on prices indicates a continued rise in the value of investment grade diamonds; 
- the diamond industry is anticipated to encounter a supply and demand gap;
- consumer demand is increasing
- diamonds represent a tangible commodity.

Name: Phoenix Capital Management (PCM)
Description:
Phoenix Capital Management (PCM) is a boutique investment firm managing $12M+ in assets whose mission is to invest in coastal hospitality real estate assets and high-quality, dividend-paying stocks of public companies. PCM believes intensity is the price of excellence. We loathe uncalculated, unappreciated, unnecessary risk. Leverage is important in maximizing returns, particularly when money is cheap - but not to the point of handicapping the firm. At the core of our investment philosophy, we ask 4 questions. If the answer isn’t yes to each question, we do not invest regardless of potential return:
•	Will this investment change lives?
•	Are we passionate about it?
•	Are we good at it? / Do we understand it?
•	Does it have market value? 
We tend to follow many of Ben Graham’s principles, though not strictly through a pass/fail lens. We invest in companies following these basic rules:
1.	Don’t buy any company for more than its book value.
2.	Always buy based on the margin of safety.
3.	Don’t chase returns.
4.	Investment operation promises safety of principal and an adequate return.
5.     Company analysis/soundness of its underlying businesses.
6.     Deliberately protect against serious losses.
7.	PCM has no interest in being temporarily right. To reach long-term financial goals, we must be sustainably and reliably right. We aim to be wrong small and right big.
8.     Adequate not excessive diversification - defined as 10-20 issues.

Our current portfolio includes BCB Bancorp (BCBP), Apple Hospitality REIT (APLE), British American Tobacco (BTI), Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP), and Main Street Capital (MAIN).

PCM also owns and manages The Dunes on Spring, a $2.2M STR duplex with 5 bedrooms in downtown Charleston as well as The Ashley and 1837 B&B, two historic beautifully renovated 9-suite B&Bs also in downtown each Charleston valued at $5M.

We are an asset management company that bases its analysis and investment decisions exclusively on science.

Our methodology applies three scientific disciplines to publicly traded companies: Chemistry. Physics. Systems Theory.

This is not algorithmic trading.
We focus exclusively on medium- and long-term investing horizons: 3, 5, 10, 15, and 20 years.

For the first time, companies are analyzed as chemical systems.
Each company is decomposed into “atoms” — every operational component and every element of its financial reporting. These elements are treated as chemical components, allowing us to study their interactions, dependencies, and structural influence on the whole system.

This approach has never before been applied to stock market analysis.
As a result, Pragma Assets operates on a methodology that is both unique and scientifically grounded.

By analyzing companies at a structural level, we identify deep patterns and systemic behaviors that remain invisible to traditional financial analysis.

Over time and across real-world application, this methodology has demonstrated its ability to construct portfolios that systematically outperform the market over medium- and long-term horizons.

Pragma Assets, Inc. evolved from Research Institute of Stock Exchange, Inc. (2022–2024) and later Scientific Technology Capital, Inc. (2024–2025), reflecting the firm’s continuous evolution and commitment to a scientific approach to asset management.
